title: Noise sensitivity from a total influence bound
statement: Let $B$ assign to each natural number $r$ a class of Boolean functions on the $r$-dimensional sign cube. Suppose $B$ is closed under negating input coordinates and under identifying input coordinates. Let $A$ assign a real number to each positive natural number, and suppose every $g\in B_r$ has total influence at most $A(r)$. Then, for every natural number $n$, every $f\in B_n$, and every positive natural number $m$, the noise sensitivity of $f$ at rate $1/m$ is at most $A(m)/m$.
